title: Wei Yan Shouts Three Times; Ma Dai Is Standing Behind Him
summary: Wei Yan, passed over, burns the gallery roads and declares against the withdrawal. Confronted, he is invited to do what Zhuge Liang predicted he would do: shout 'who dares kill me?' three times in front of the army. He gets to the third, and Ma Dai — who has been riding beside him for a fortnight under sealed orders — takes his head off.
In Luoyang, Cao Rui builds pleasure gardens and moves bronze statues, and Wei begins to rot from the top.
history: Wei Yan's death is historical, though it was a succession quarrel rather than a revolt. The silk-bag stratagem is the novel's, and it is Zhuge Liang's last word.

pins.note: Riding beside him under sealed orders.
